<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="{= meta.lang}">
  <head>
    {:og_image = meta.og_image ?? links.assets + '/og.png'}
    <title>{= title | default(meta.site)}</title>
    {+ parts/head.tpl}
  </head>
  <body>
    <script nonce="{= nonce}">
var page = {= json(page) | raw};
$(function () { init({ debug: false }); });
</script>
    {?# content}
      <main>{# content}</main>
    {:}
      <main class="empty">No content</main>
    {/}
    {# parts/footer.tpl links year:date(now(), 'Y')}
  </body>
</html>
